notes: Pin functions above are generic SAE J1962 OBD-II assignments only. Factory documentation reviewed for the 1999 USDM Legacy describes a 16-pin DLC shared by OBD-II and Subaru SSM but does not provide a verified per-pin vehicle mapping in this repository. Manufacturer-discretionary positions (1, 3, 8, 9, 11-13) and any Subaru-specific SSM terminals must be established from the correct factory wiring diagram before any hardware connects. See docs/OBD2_INTERFACE.md.
